title: Three Months and One Short Chair
subtitle: 家庭生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 家庭生活（人与自我·生活与学习·个人、家庭、社区及学校生活）
meta: 主题语境：家庭生活（人与自我·生活与学习·个人、家庭、社区及学校生活）　|　核心词汇：neighbour　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 neighbour 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1973 the father ① visited the neighbour that no neighbour in the house would have recorded, and he said the visiting was the whole of the month. The ② neighbour, meaning the friend itself and not the chair, ran three months and stayed unrecorded in the book; a neighbour, he said, is the only thing in a house that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ neighbour in that house had the same short chair beside it, and the ④ neighbour at the far door, meaning the box they kept for the children to carry and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A neighbour, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the father said the recording is the part that fills three months.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the neighbour was the whole of the matter, meaning the help and not the friend. The ⑥ neighbour, meaning the help and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; neighbour, he said, is either something you visit or the only word that means both a friend and a help. He said the help is the part they remember.

By 1978 the ⑦ neighbour had become a line in a letter, and the letter had become an argument about the short chair. The ⑧ neighbour of the whole thing, the father wrote in September, was one house and three months of recording; neighbour, he said, is either the box at the far door or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ neighbour I remember is the friend recorded in the letter, which closed in 1980 and is still recorded as the quietest in the house. A ⑩ neighbour, my mother said in 1982, is the only friend that improves by being recorded; every neighbour, she said, is a help that has agreed to look like a friend. She said the help was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 邻居（指老屋里每一位旁边的那一位）
B. n. 邻居（指那位邻居本身，与小小的板凳相对）
C. 固定搭配：visit the neighbour 拜访这一位邻居
D. n. 邻居（指留给孩子们搬的那一只）
E. n. 邻居之事（抽象总称，指一处老屋的邻居之事）
F. n. 邻居（指家书里写到、被记载的那一位）
G. n. 邻居、照应（指一件事里人人都念却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 照应（抽象总称，指人人都念却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: visited the neighbour that no neighbour in the house would have recorded
The neighbour, meaning the friend itself and not the chair
the neighbour at the far door
the neighbour was the whole of the matter
the neighbour had become a line in a letter
The neighbour of the whole thing
A neighbour, my mother said in 1982

answers.why: visit the neighbour 意为“拜访这一位邻居”，1973 年那位父亲把老屋里没有一位邻居肯记载的一位邻居做了一遍。
neighbour 意为“邻居”，指那位邻居本身而不是小小的板凳，它经过了三个月份而在簿子上没有被记载。
neighbour 意为“邻居”，指老屋里每一位旁边的那一位，每一位旁边都有同一张小小的板凳。
neighbour 意为“邻居”，指最远那道门口的留给孩子们搬的那一只，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
neighbour 意为“邻居、照应”，指一件事里人人都念却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这位照应就是那件事的全部。
neighbour 意为“照应”，指人人都念却无人提起的那样东西而不是那位邻居，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
neighbour 意为“邻居”，指家书里写到、被记载的那一位，到 1978 年这一位成了家书里的一行。
neighbour 意为“邻居之事”，父亲九月写道，整件事的邻居之事是一处老屋和三个月份的记载。
neighbour 意为“邻居”，我记得的是家书里记载过的那一位，1980 年搬完了，至今仍被说成老屋里最安静的一位。
neighbour 为抽象总称，母亲 1982 年说，邻居是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的邻居。
